methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 11 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in AI & Software. Range: $3.2B - $39.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Applied Intuition, a Series F AI & Software company, has raised over $600M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 11 same-sector peers at similar valuation tiers, including 1 public company (Palantir) and 8 private firms such as Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI. The peer set ranges from $3.2B to $39.0B in valuation.

Stage-progression methodology was excluded due to data integrity concerns: the stated $15.0B post-money valuation implies a multiple exceeding 25x total capital raised, a threshold that suggests potential misreporting. Peer-median analysis therefore anchors the valuation. Across the 11-company peer set, the median valuation is $8.6B, with a range from $3.2B (low) to $39.0B (high). This single applicable method yields an implied valuation of $8.6B.

The triangulated range is $7.3B to $9.9B, centered at $8.6B. This reflects the peer-median approach applied to Applied Intuition's funding stage and sector positioning. Primary uncertainty stems from the small methodological base (one applicable method) and the wide dispersion within the peer set, which spans nearly 12x from minimum to maximum. Validation against revenue multiples, customer concentration, and unit economics would refine this range materially.
